name: Not Only the Way
tagline: You'd never call it pride. You'd call it doing it properly.
epigraph: Two things in this glass. The second was made before anyone asked for it.
glassware: a coupe (a stemmed glass with a rounded bowl), chilled

names_note: **Not Only the Way**, the room's pick (all three): his relayed words (Regan, secondary), glossed "proud of a way, and leaving room for others". Also considered: *Tender* (Hester; names his bar, and would half-say "his recipe"), *Keeps Well* (Hester), *Holds Up*, *Properly*, *The Back of the Drawer* (Tomás), *It'll Do* (rejected: the guest fears mediocrity).
open_items: **Celery family (unsourced):** caraway is in the celery (Apiaceae) family, which isn't in the veto list; Tomás's own knowledge, labelled unsourced. Robin's call on whether it needs a veto note.

**Closing line alternative:** the room set the short form, "When someone says it's good, say caraway."; the long form, "When someone says it's good, don't say it was nothing. Say caraway.", is recorded for Robin.

**New ingredient row:** `lime_caraway_cordial`, values computed from Tomás's recipe (150 ml lime, 90 g sugar, 90 ml water, zest of 4 limes, 1 tsp caraway; about 300 ml, six drinks). One edge: gin at exactly 40% gives initial strength 22.9 against a 23 floor.

**Secondary source:** Uyeda's "not only the way" and "mellow and easy to drink" come to us relayed (a London consultant's question, a forum, Regan), labelled secondary. He spoke next to no English in New York; a translator was used (*A Proper Drink* p. 208).

**Contested:** whether he ever claimed his shake was superior (Oxford "he claims" vs Klemm "never said"). The shaking tests (Arnold, Cecchini, Klemm) found no measurable difference; Cecchini is kept out of the reading (*Still Yours*' man).
**Ours, never his:** a Gimlet in his honour; the library doesn't say whether Tender's Gimlet used cordial. "Shake it however you shake" is our instruction from his "not only the way".

**Runner-up:** Joe Sheridan's Irish Coffee (hot, dairy; set aside because a warm drink handed over belongs to the whole Caregiver family). Also considered: Lauchlan Rose's lime cordial (reads as business; kept as one clause).
